summary: Solaris Resources Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the results of its Annual General Meeting of shareholders. Shareholders voted to elect five director nominees, appoint BDO Canada LLP as auditors, and ratify unallocated stock option plan entitlements. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is identified. This is a routine annual meeting disclosure under Canadian and U.S. reporting requirements, with no material corporate action triggering a special-situation classification.
